pages.text: The quest book (ESC → Quests) is a road map, not a gate: nothing is locked behind it except dragon armour, which waits on Dragon Slayer I as the rune platebody does in RuneScape. Every quest pays XP, coins and a roll on a reward crate, and the crate gets better as the quests get harder. Finish a chapter and its last quest hands out a prize worth the trip.
$(bold)Ctrl + mouse wheel$() zooms the quest map. Drag to pan. Click a quest to read it and to claim its rewards once it is done.

pages.title: Chapters
pages.text: Thirty-three chapters. The Ages are the main road through Create; the Main Quests (below) only show up once someone gives them to you; the rest are questlines you dip into whenever they fit what you are doing.

pages.title: Main quests
pages.text: RuneScape style: Lemurton's people have troubles of their own, and a quest only appears in your book (under $(bold)Main Quests$()) once someone has given it to you. Its steps then show up one at a time as you go, and the rewards hand themselves over. Right-click everyone; the ones with a quest say so.

murton) - See below - 2 quest points, the right to wear dragon armour, Attack and Defence XP, 25,000 coins and more$(br2)$(bold)Dragon Slayer I$(), as in RuneScape: Oziach, who keeps the armoury on the ring street, tells you how to reach Elvarg on the isle of Crandor.

1. Get an $(bold)Anti-dragon Shield$() from Mayor Thaddeus. Held in either hand, it lets through only a fifth of a dragon's breath, and her fire won't catch on you. 2. Find the three pieces of the map: $(bold)Lucan the Jeweller$() sells one for 10,000 coins, $(bold)Wizard Traiborn$() (in his tower by the wall) trades one for a ghast tear, a blaze rod and an amethyst shard, and the $(bold)Champions' Guild$() gives the third for its trial (20 zombies and 10 skeletons). 3. pages.title: How rewards scale
pages.text: Every quest has a tier. The tier sets its XP, its coins and the crate it rolls on once:

$(#b9a98a)Tier - XP - Coins - Crate - What the crate holds$()$(br)$(bold)1 Settler$() - 25 - 80 - Settler's Supplies - Ingots, alloy, torches, food, coal, arrows, tea$(br)$(bold)2 Engineer$() - 60 - 240 - Engineer's Crate - Cogs, shafts, casing, sheets, belts, funnels, zinc, upgrade bases$(br)$(bold)3 Artisan$() - 150 - 480 - Artisan's Crate - Brass, precision mechanisms, sturdy sheets, machines, backpack upgrades, warp scrolls, feasts$(br)$(bold)4 Master$() - 400 - 1,280 - Master's Cache - Enchanted books, relics, warp and portal scrolls, mechanical arms, gear tools, advanced backpack upgrades$(br)$(bold)5 Legen

d$() - 1000 - 5,120 - Legend's Hoard - Relics, Duelist's Patterns, loot-only gear, warp stones, waystones, netherite, totems, Mending$(br2)Hover a crate in the reward list to see everything in it and the odds. Chapter finales add fixed prizes on top (gear pieces, relics, coins, capes), so the last quest of a line is always worth reaching.

$(li)XP is vanilla experience, for enchanting; it does not train skills.$(br)$(li)Coins are Gold Coins, one stack however many you have. Spend them at the vendors or trade them; see $(l:lemursaucepacket:economy)Coins, vendors and trading$(/l).$(br)$(li)Team progress is shared: if you are in a team, everyone gets the quest and can claim its rewards.

pages.title: The Skills chapter
pages.text: Every Project MMO skill has a milestone quest at 10, 25, 50, 75 and 99, and the total-level ladder runs 100, 250, 500, 750, 1000 and Maxed (1386, every skill at 99). You cannot tick these: the server reads your levels every few seconds, and shortly after you log in, and completes the ones you have reached. A chat line tells you, with a link to the book, and the reward waits there to be claimed.

The rewards climb with the level: a Settler crate at 10, a Legend's Hoard at 99. Level 50 and 75 add a prize made for the skill (the Excavator's Pickaxe for Mining, the Stormcaller's Sabre for Attack, an elytra for Agility, a relic for Cooking). Level 99 pays 40,000 coins, a relic and two rolls on the Legend's Hoard, and the skill's cape unlocks by itself ($(#e0ac46)/capes$()). Maxed is 80,000 coins and the Maxed Cape.
